rules.title: Dynamic code execution from a JavaScript/TypeScript call site
rules.description: eval() and new Function() create a code execution boundary. Reachability and input control must be verified before this can be reported as a vulnerability.

rules.title: Request or user input reaches a command execution API
rules.description: A request-controlled value appears in a child_process execution call. A verifier must prove attacker reachability and command impact.

rules.title: Request-controlled redirect target
rules.description: A redirect target appears to use request-controlled data. Verify whether an allowlist or same-origin constraint exists.

rules.title: Request-controlled value reaches a query execution call
rules.description: A request-controlled value appears in a query or execute call. Parameterization and actual reachability must be verified.

rules.title: Dynamic code execution from a Python call site
rules.description: eval() and exec() create a Python code execution boundary. Reachability and input control must be verified before this can be reported as a vulnerability.

rules.title: Request or user input reaches a Python command execution API
rules.description: A request-controlled value appears in os.system, os.popen, or subprocess execution. A verifier must prove attacker reachability and command impact.

rules.title: Request-controlled value reaches a Python query execution call
rules.description: A request-controlled value appears in a database execute call. Parameterization and actual reachability must be independently verified.

rules.title: Request-controlled template source in Python
rules.description: User-controlled data appears to reach a server-side template source. A validator must demonstrate template expression impact.

rules.title: Request-controlled URL reaches a Python outbound request API
rules.description: A request-controlled URL appears to reach an outbound request sink. Scheme, host, port, DNS, and redirect policy require verification.

rules.title: Request-controlled redirect target in Python
rules.description: A redirect target appears to use request-controlled data. Same-origin and allowlist constraints require verification.

rules.title: Untrusted XML reaches an unsafe Python parser
rules.description: Request-controlled XML reaches an XML parser or entity-capable configuration. External entities and network access require independent validation.

rules.title: Untrusted data reaches unsafe Python deserialization
rules.description: User-controlled bytes reach pickle, marshal, or an unsafe YAML loader. A validator must prove object construction or execution impact.

rules.title: Request-controlled path reaches a Python file sink
rules.description: An external path reaches open or file-serving code without a proven containment policy.

rules.title: Credential-like literal in Python source
rules.description: Secret-shaped literals in Python source may be active credentials. Rotate and verify their deployment boundary before closing the obligation.

rules.title: Python application debug mode enabled
rules.description: Debug mode can expose stack traces and interactive tooling. Deployment configuration must be checked before treating this as exploitable.
